title: Serve related samples and clips from current local audio vectors
description: Purpose: real native Apricity POST /semantic/related for current library sample/clip pages, stored vectors only. Prerequisites accepted M1 local retrieval/cache/hydration and M2 representative/ranking contract; isolated tests may precede upstream completion, rollout waits for supervision. Allowed crates/apricity-cli/src/semantic.rs and serve.rs tests plus one focused Cucumber binding. Excludes cloud HTTP, UI, encoder, schema changes, publication, deployment. Exact request {embeddingSpace,sampleId,clipId?,limit?}; strict types/unknown fields, default6,max24; 400 invalid,409 space,503 unavailable corpus with retryable. Response {state:ready|awaiting_analysis,hits}; no source vector exposed. Hydrate all eligible source regions against current canonical state; clip only own saved vector, never parent substitute. Sample up to4 deterministic farthest-point valid records seeded smallest semanticId, min(1-dot) maxima/ties ID. One bounded100 candidate search per representative; exclude source sample before final limit, rehydrate current candidates, best score by semanticId, sample suggestions group sampleId best passage, clip suggestions saved clips only. First strongest per recording then score remainder. Canonical playback boundaries and metadata, no retired/missing/changed/hidden results. Cache only immutable validated corpus, no crossquery canonical cache. Tests first RED on native route; deterministic e0/e1 fixtures multiple samples/recordings/source clips/windows, edited/retired/missing source, stale candidates, invalid/corrupt corpus, limits/ties and zero model loading. Commands stable explicit RUSTC cargo test -p apricity-cli semantic::tests and serve::tests then release build; supervisor reruns real library HTTP/playback. Preserve running preview and web/dist; no restarts by Terra. Handoff diff RED/GREEN counts and unresolved issues; no Kanbus/git/deploy/close actions by Terra.

comments.text: Dispatch native related service after stored clip port review landed79d79d3b; local exact corpus/cache/current canonical contracts already accepted. Implement clip own-vector and sample farthest-point/ranking in local adapter with immutable corpus but request-current guards. Cloud sample orchestration and UI integration remain separate. Do not restart live5181 or write web/dist; supervisor reruns then swaps accepted binary only.
